name: hub-authentication
goal: Verified Google sign-in, GitHub owner proof and a one-time native session handoff for the hosted hub

evidence: Scope and acceptance in specification/features/planned/hub-authentication.md. Types written to src/models/HubAuth.types.ts and HubAuthStore.types.ts and published in the control auth-contract.md before implementation. Email decision: only Google-authoritative addresses sign in.

src/lib/server/auth.ts exports createHubAuth and createD1AuthStore. Google RS256 verification (GoogleIdentityService), opaque hashed sessions (SessionRepository, RequestSessionService), one-time login challenge, native PKCE handoff, GitHub grant with sealed tokens, live owner proof, scoped installation tokens, D1 adapter and db/migrations/0001-auth-ephemeral-state.sql. Scaffolds came from harness generate service, adapter, validator, controller, util, migration, feature.

Red first against generated stubs, per group: 20 utility, 12 Google, 13 store and record, 22 session, 10 native handoff, 41 GitHub, 36 HTTP tests failing. Green: bunx vitest run on the 24 auth test files, 167 passed. A fake token endpoint that answers form-encoded like github.com then failed 11 tests on a wrong Accept header; repaired; 167 passed. Real RSA for Google and the app JWT, real SQLite for the D1 adapter.

title: Run the auth module on the Workers runtime with a local D1.

evidence: A probe in local workerd (wrangler dev, compatibility 2026-10-12) showed fetch with redirect 'error' throws there. Red: 29 tests against a fake that refuses it. Repaired with redirect 'manual' and any 3xx refused; 169 passed. Then the real module was served from a throwaway worker with the migration applied to local D1: 23 of 23 checks passed, including six concurrent exchanges giving 200 once and 400 five times, and logout revoking the native session. Google sign-in and GitHub calls were not exercised there: no provider is registered.

title: Close the GitHub grant revocation races and bound the auth request body.

evidence: Red on the previous code, unchanged afterwards: 7 tests holding a synthetic GitHub call (disconnect during rotation, disconnect during callback, older callback against newer connection, reconnection during a rotation that succeeds, and one that is refused, three concurrent callers, outage then lease) and 2 streamed-body tests. Repair: migration 0003, generation compare-and-swap, rotation lease, tombstones, streamed reader with cancel at 16 KiB. Green: 25 auth files, 189 tests. Real local D1 in workerd: 17 of 17 grant checks, with one winner among four concurrent connections and among four lease claims.

In packages/hub: HARNESS_CLI_PATH=../../src/index.ts bun run check exited 0. prettier --check clean, svelte-check 678 files 0 errors, eslint clean, vitest 45 files 229 tests passed, vite build done with adapter-cloudflare, Harness audit passed. Not covered by this command: the root check, hub Playwright tests, and any call to the real Google or GitHub, which are not registered.

title: Admit Google accounts outside Gmail and Workspace through a mailbox proof.

evidence: Red first: 28 failing tests against generated stubs. Then green: 28 auth test files, 231 tests, covering pending-only sign-in, forged credentials, no actor or GitHub or native access while pending, attempts, lock, expiry, replay, concurrent verify and send, resend, send caps, logout in every order against a verification in flight, isolation by origin, cookie, bearer, subject and address, provider failure and redirect, and no logging. Store contract on memory and on D1 over real SQLite; real local D1 in workerd 15 of 15, with sixteen parallel wrong guesses spending exactly five attempts. eslint and prettier clean for these files, vite build done, package unit suite 55 files 288 tests. Not passing at package level, outside this work: svelte-check error in src/utils/hubSnapshot.ts, eslint complexity in src/utils/hubEntity.ts, audit complexity in src/utils/hubCache.ts. No email was sent and no provider was called.
